Lessons.Title: Length Measurements
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will apply your understanding of multiplicative comparison and unit conversion to solve multi-step problems about distances and lengths.
Previously, you reasoned multiplicatively about measurements and performed unit conversions to solve problems in the context of mass and capacity.
Core relationship: Length measurements and comparisons. Record lengths with a consistent unit and compare converted measurements.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:   Which One Doesn’t Belong: Measurements	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Frisbee Throws	 (15 minutes); Activity 2:  Stone Towers	 (20 minutes); Cool-down:  A Sculptor and a Tower	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: Convert 5 meters to centimeters.
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): What length is longer: 230 cm or 2 m?
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Counting an uneven measurement gap as a full equal unit.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: It changes the unit, place value, or operation.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Record lengths with a consistent unit and compare converted measurements.
